name: Mirror Lake of Dream Reflections
description: A perfectly still lake that reflects not the surroundings but the dreams of those who gaze into it, shifting in surreal imagery.
prompt: A tranquil lake at twilight, surface like a flawless mirror. Instead of trees, the reflection shows fantastical dreamscapes — floating cities, winged whales, stairways to clouds — each unique. Soft glow, high detail, 8K.
caption: Look down and see the dreams you never knew you had. 🌙🪞 #MirrorLakeDreams
